name: CDU Student Assistance Grant
summary: A one-off $150 payment each semester for CDU award-course students who explain their financial need.
who: Enrolled in a CDU award course (enabling, TAFE, higher education or research) with at least one unit in the current teaching period.
Not open to short course, study abroad or exchange students.
how: Submit the Scholarship Application Form with a statement of 250 words or fewer on your financial situation.
catches: Covers one semester. Paid by transfer within 7 days of a complete form.

source.label: CDU: Student Assistance Grant terms, Semester 1 2026
